label: Diagram 5.2
caption: Diagram 5.2 | Annealed glass thickness and dimension limits
description: This is a stepped chart, titled in a green band at the bottom: "Diagram 5.2 Annealed glass thickness and dimension limits". The top-left corner reads "See para 5.5". Two axes frame the drawing. The vertical axis, shown with arrows, lists from bottom to top: 1.10m, 2.25m, 3.0m, and Any. The horizontal axis, also with arrows, lists from left to right: 1.10m, 2.25m, 4.50m, and Any. A single stepped line divides the chart into four stepped regions, each holding a thickness label. The smallest lower-left region is labelled 8mm. The next region up and to the right is labelled 10mm. The following region is labelled 12mm. The largest top-right region is labelled 15mm. The step lines align with the axis values: the 8mm region is bounded at 1.10m on both axes; the 10mm region at 2.25m; the 12mm region at 4.50m horizontally and 3.0m vertically; and the 15mm region extends to Any on both axes.
